## Before/after significance (paired bootstrap, episodes resampled; 10000 resamples, seed 20261113, percentile 95% interval)

| metric | v0 | v1 | change (pp) | 95% CI (pp) | gained / lost | bootstrap P(change<=0) | exact McNemar p |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| resolution | 83/100 | 93/100 | +10.0 | [+1.0, +19.0] | 16 / 6 | 0.0170 | 0.0525 |
| injection refusal (6 episodes) | 3/6 | 6/6 | +50.0 | [+16.7, +83.3] | 3 / 0 | 0.0159 | 0.2500 |

Sensitivity: resampling the 50 scenarios (each run twice, with two personas) instead of single episodes gives a resolution 95% CI of [+0.0, +20.0] pp. Injection refusal rests on 6 episodes (3 flipped, 0 reversed); treat its interval as indicative only.
